column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(30)) for each product listing (e.g., 'PROD-12345').
An enum (ProdTheme_enum) for the product's main category (Digital, Data, Service, Physical).
An enum (ProdSubcat_enum) specifying the product subcategory (Type_A, Type_B, Type_C, Type_D).
An INT showing how many days the listing has been on the market (e.g., 14).
A NUMERIC(10,2) price of the product in USD (e.g., 199.99).
FK referencing Vendors(VendRegistry) indicating which vendor offers this product.
FK referencing Buyers(BuyRegistry), if reserved or linked to a specific buyer.
